definition: Water that flows over the surface of land into streams and rivers, typically after rain or snowmelt; can also refer to a final election or competition held to determine a winner when previous results were tied or inconclusive.
translation: 徑流；地表逕流（雨水或融雪流入溪流河川的水）；或決選（當先前結果打平或不夠明確時舉行的最終選舉或競賽）
example: Heavy runoff from the storm caused the creek to overflow its banks.
